Architectural utility reimagined with recycled 1000D ballistic nylon, vegetable-tanned Italian leather and modular magnetic mechanics. Calibrated for creators, executives and modern nomads.

faqs.question: Will this pack fit under commercial airplane seats?
faqs.answer: Yes. At 48cm × 31cm × 18cm, The Apex Commuter meets standard under-seat personal item rules for IndiGo, Air India, Emirates, British Airways, Lufthansa and most major carriers.

faqs.question: How does the 16" laptop cradle protect against drops?
faqs.answer: The laptop bay has a false bottom suspended 2.5 cm above the backpack's floor, so the laptop never contacts the ground directly, even on hard impacts.

faqs.question: Is the backpack 100% waterproof or water resistant?
faqs.answer: It is certified IPX6 weather-tight: 840D recycled ballistic nylon, laminated PU backing and YKK AquaGuard® zippers handle monsoon downpours. It is not designed for full submersion.

faqs.question: How does the lifetime repair warranty work?
faqs.answer: If any hardware, seam or fastener fails, raise a claim from your account. We send a prepaid pickup and repair or replace the part free of charge.

faqs.question: How should I care for the leather?
faqs.answer: Wipe with a dry cloth and condition every 3–4 months with a neutral leather balm. Keep it away from prolonged direct sunlight.

faqs.question: Is the leather ethically sourced?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our hides come from LWG Gold-rated tanneries using vegetable tanning agents from tree bark and mimosa extracts.
